description: Collaboration expense review: read the approval requests that just reached the owner's inbox, review them against the owner's guideline documents, email the owner a suggested decision.

globals.name: owner_email
globals.description: Owner mailbox address, set by Collaboration

globals.name: timezone
globals.description: Owner time zone the review is dated in, set by Collaboration

globals.name: thread_ids
globals.description: Brain thread id of each request, set by the mail import

globals.name: message_keys
globals.description: Brain message key of each request email, in the same order

# Email the review to the owner as Deloitte-styled HTML; the only links are the requests' own Outlook links. import html import json import bs4 import markdown from semoss import Insight TITLE = "Expense Review" FOOTER = ("Prepared by SEMOSS Collaboration from the approval request and your guideline documents. " "This is a suggested decision for your review; nothing was approved, declined or sent on your behalf. " "Respond from the original request email or the MES Meeting & Event Approval Dashboard.") FONT = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" # Deloitte palette: black, Deloitte green (accents only; too light for text), cool grays, accessible link blue. BLACK = "#000000" GREEN = "#86BC25" GRAY_TEXT = "#53565A" GRAY_LINE = "#D0D0CE" GRAY_FILL = "#F2F2F2" BLUE = "#0076A8" MAX_SUBJECT = 120 # Outlook ignores most stylesheet CSS, so every element gets inline styles. STYLES = { "h1": "margin:24px 0 8px; padding:0 0 6px; border-bottom:2px solid " + GREEN + "; font-size:20px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "h2": "margin:24px 0 8px; padding:0 0 6px; border-bottom:2px solid " + GREEN + "; font-size:18px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "h3": "margin:16px 0 6px; font-size:15px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "p": "margin:0 0 10px;", "ul": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:0 0 0 20px;", "ol": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:0 0 0 20px;", "li": "margin:0 0 6px;", "a": "color:" + BLUE + "; text-decoration:underline;", "strong": "color:" + BLACK + ";", "table": "border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; margin:0 0 12px;", "th": "padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + "; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; text-align:left;", "td": "padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + ";", "blockquote": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:4px 12px; border-left:3px solid " + GREEN + "; color:" + GRAY_TEXT + ";", "code": "font-family:Consolas, monospace; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; padding:1px 4px;", "hr": "border:0; border-top:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + "; margin:16px 0;", } DECISION_STYLE = ("margin:14px 0; padding:10px 14px; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; border-left:4px solid " + GREEN + "; font-size:15px; color:" + BLACK + ";") def _pixel_value(name, value): # Pixel decodes \u escapes, so mail text can never open an tag in the Pixel. return name + "=[" + json.dumps(value).replace("<", "\\u003c") + "]" def _links(requests): # The request's own Outlook link, from Graph, so the owner responds from the original email. items = "" for request in requests: label = html.escape(str(request.get("subject") or "Request")) link = str(request.get("webLink") or "") if link.startswith("https://"): label = '' + label + "" items += '
  • ' + label + "
    • " if not items: return "" return ('

    Respond from the original request

      ' + items + "
    ") def _email(content, date): return ( '' '
    ' '' '' '' '' '' '
    ' 'Deloitte' '.' '
    ' + TITLE + ' · ' + html.escape(date) + '
    ' '
     
    ' + content + '
    ' + FOOTER + '
    ' ) def run(scope): recipient = str(scope.get("owner_email") or "").strip() if not recipient: raise ValueError("There is no owner mailbox address to send to.") requests = list(scope["context"].get("requests") or []) # Escape raw HTML first, so only Markdown formatting reaches the email. escaped = str(scope["review"]).replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<") soup = bs4.BeautifulSoup(markdown.markdown(escaped, extensions=["tables"]), "html.parser") for image in soup.find_all("img"): image.decompose() for link in soup.find_all("a"): # the model writes no links of its own; the request links come from the data below link.unwrap() for tag in soup.find_all(list(STYLES)): tag["style"] = STYLES[tag.name] for paragraph in soup.find_all("p"): if paragraph.get_text().lstrip().lower().startswith("suggested decision"): paragraph["style"] = DECISION_STYLE date = str(scope["context"]["today"]) body = _email(str(soup) + _links(requests), date) if len(requests) == 1 and requests[0].get("subject"): subject = str(requests[0]["subject"]).strip() subject = TITLE + ": " + (subject if len(subject) <= MAX_SUBJECT else subject[:MAX_SUBJECT].rstrip() + "...") else: subject = TITLE + ": " + str(len(requests)) + " requests - " + date pixel = "MicrosoftOutlookSendMail(" + ", ".join([ _pixel_value("to", [recipient]), _pixel_value("subject", subject), _pixel_value("body", body), _pixel_value("html", True), ]) + ");" ret = Insight().run_pixel(pixel, raw=True) last = ret[0]["pixelReturn"][-1] if "ERROR" in str(last.get("operationType")): raise RuntimeError("Sending the review failed: " + str(last.get("output"))) return {"sent": True, "to": recipient, "subject": subject, "html": body}
